about_the_game: Featuring 113 full color pages of art, lore, trivia, never-before-seen official works, and even a fan-submitted Q&A section, this artbook is perfect for anyone craving more Soundless! Additionally, the PDF is tagged for screen readers, and all images have alt text, including alternative text that describes the characters' appearances again to refresh anyone's memory.

content_descriptors.notes: This artbook contains uncensored, high definition art assets with gore and violence.
